definition: a small piece broken off something
description: Close-up of an old wooden surface covered in cracked, blistered cream paint. A hand pushes a wide metal scraper under the paint and small chips and flakes break off and fall away, leaving patches of bare orange wood, and the scraper keeps going until a large area is stripped.
transcript: Wow, you scrape all that old paint right off.
